Definition: Shemiramoth, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Shemiramoth = "name of heights"; 1) a Merarite Levite in the second rank in the choir of David; 2) a Levite in the time of king Jehoshaphat of Judah
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
